verdict.reasons: Product identity is correct and authentic; the AFP brand and legitimate water-drop symbol are visible and readable. However, the installation evidence does not match the technical specification: the scene shows standard round black supply pipes and an open-ended joint rather than the required closed ribbed compression union or flat lateral tape lines. This technical mismatch prevents a passing score despite correct branding and product family.

focused_physical_review.reason: The image shows a single required white-and-blue AFP package containing a roll, with no distinct additional loose coils present. While the irrigation line does not physically touch or cross the package footprint, the clear_soil_gap condition is not met as a black irrigation pipe is visible in the background running parallel to the package, interrupting the soil space. No protruding strips or tape tails are visible on the package sides or base.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
